title: Unique Number of Occurrences
summary: For an integer array arr, determine if the frequency of each value is distinct; return true if so, otherwise return false.
statement: For an integer array arr, determine if the frequency of each value is distinct; return true if so, otherwise return false.
constraints: Return whether no two distinct values have the same frequency.
hints: Count each distinct value, then inspect the resulting frequencies.
Frequency values must themselves contain no duplicate.
Compare the number of frequencies with the size of their set.
Equal sizes mean every distinct input value has a different occurrence count.
editorial: Equal sizes mean every distinct input value has a different occurrence count.

tests.explanation: Frequencies three, two, and one are all distinct.
Both values occur once, so the counts are not unique.
